p-phenylenediamine.reason: PPD: strong skin sensitizer and the most common cause of hair-dye allergy; reactions can be severe.

toluene-2,5-diamine.reason: PTD: strong skin sensitizer closely related to PPD; people allergic to PPD often react to it too.

toluene-2,5-diamine sulfate.reason: PTD: strong skin sensitizer closely related to PPD; people allergic to PPD often react to it too.

p-aminophenol.reason: Strong skin sensitizer used in permanent dyes; often cross-reacts with PPD.

o-aminophenol.reason: Skin sensitizer; restricted or banned in hair dyes in some regions.

lead acetate.reason: Lead compound once used in gradual (progressive) dyes; no longer allowed in hair dyes in the EU or US.

n,n-bis(2-hydroxyethyl)-p-phenylenediami.reason: PPD derivative; can cause skin sensitization.

p-methylaminophenol sulfate.reason: Skin sensitizer used in permanent dyes.

m-aminophenol.reason: Skin sensitizer used in permanent dyes.

resorcinol.reason: Skin sensitizer and irritant used in permanent dyes.

4-chlororesorcinol.reason: Skin sensitizer used in permanent dyes.

4-amino-2-hydroxytoluene.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

4-amino-m-cresol.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

2-amino-3-hydroxypyridine.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

2-amino-4-hydroxyethylaminoanisole sulfa.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

2-methyl-5-hydroxyethylaminophenol.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

2,4-diaminophenoxyethanol hcl.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

1,3-bis-(2,4-diaminophenoxy)propane hcl.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

6-methoxy-2-methylamino-3-aminopyridine.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

hydroxyethoxy aminopyrazolopyridine hcl.reason: Permanent dye ingredient that can cause skin sensitization.

sodium picramate.reason: Skin sensitizer sometimes added to henna-based dyes.

2-methylresorcinol.reason: Permanent dye ingredient; weak skin sensitizer.

hydrogen peroxide.reason: Developer; can irritate the scalp and skin, especially at higher strengths.

ammonia.reason: Can irritate the scalp, eyes and airways.

ethanolamine.reason: Ammonia substitute; can irritate the scalp.

lawsonia inermis.reason: Henna. Pure henna rarely causes allergy, but "black henna" may contain PPD.

basic brown 17.reason: Semi-permanent dye; can cause skin reactions in some people.

basic red 76.reason: Semi-permanent dye; can cause skin reactions in some people.

hc blue no 16.reason: Semi-permanent dye; can cause skin reactions in some people.

sodium lauryl sulfate.reason: Harsh sulfate cleanser; strips dye and speeds color fading.

ammonium lauryl sulfate.reason: Harsh sulfate cleanser; strips dye and speeds color fading.

sodium coco-sulfate.reason: Coconut-derived but mostly sodium lauryl sulfate; strips dye and speeds color fading.

sodium c14-16 olefin sulfonate.reason: Strong sulfate-free cleanser; about as stripping as sulfates for color.

sodium laureth sulfate.reason: Sulfate cleanser; milder than sodium lauryl sulfate but still fades color over time.

ammonium laureth sulfate.reason: Sulfate cleanser; milder than ammonium lauryl sulfate but still fades color over time.

sodium myreth sulfate.reason: Sulfate cleanser; fades color over repeated washes.

sodium c12-13 pareth sulfate.reason: Sulfate cleanser; fades color over repeated washes.

tea-lauryl sulfate.reason: Sulfate cleanser; fades color over repeated washes.

sodium dodecylbenzenesulfonate.reason: Strong detergent; strips dye and dries hair.

tea-dodecylbenzenesulfonate.reason: Strong detergent; strips dye and dries hair.

hydrogen peroxide.reason: Oxidizer that lightens hair; can shift or fade existing color.

ammonium persulfate.reason: Bleach booster; lifts color and weakens already-processed hair.

potassium persulfate.reason: Bleach booster; lifts color and weakens already-processed hair.

sodium persulfate.reason: Bleach booster; lifts color and weakens already-processed hair.

sodium hydrosulfite.reason: Main active in color removers; breaks down permanent dye.

ammonium thioglycolate.reason: Perm/straightening agent; breaks hair bonds and can fade or shift color.

sodium thioglycolate.reason: Perm/straightening agent; breaks hair bonds and can fade or shift color.

calcium hydroxide.reason: No-lye relaxer base; very high pH opens the cuticle and lets color escape.

ammonia.reason: Alkaline; opens the cuticle so dye washes out faster.

ethanolamine.reason: Alkaline ammonia substitute; opens the cuticle so dye washes out faster.

sodium carbonate.reason: Alkaline; opens the cuticle so dye washes out faster.

selenium sulfide.reason: Anti-dandruff active known to discolor dyed and light hair.

sodium bicarbonate.reason: Baking soda; mildly alkaline and used in DIY color removal.

alcohol denat.reason: Drying alcohol; can dull color on dry, processed hair.

isopropyl alcohol.reason: Drying alcohol; can dull color on dry, processed hair.
